messages:
Priya (CSM): Quick sync — Kestrel (enterprise onboarding cohort 2) asked for a recurring drop-in training for new seats. Thinking 60m weekly starting Wed 2025-06-04 10:00 PDT. Who can lead and own agenda?
Noah (Solutions Eng): I can do first two sessions if Sofia or Evan can cover follow-ups. Can we focus first week on quickstarter + API walkthrough, second week on best practices (batching, caching, cost controls)?
Sofia (Training): +1. I'll draft a 45m deck + 10m Q&A. Plan: 10m intros, 20m quickstart demo, 15m config + troubleshooting, 15m Q&A — can compress.
Evan (Customer Success Manager): Attendee list will be ~12 seats, mix of devs and infra. Ask them to bring example prompts and a sample throughput target so we can tailor the batching/caching section. Also flag any compliance questions up front.
Jordan (PM): Can we include a 5-min callout about Dedicated vs Hosted routing? A lot of customers ask about predictable latency.
Noah (Solutions Eng): Good call. I'll add a short slide and a 3-slide appendix for dedicated/private config snippets.
Priya (CSM): Cool. Logistics: can someone create the recurring calendar invite and include these pre-reqs:
- create API key and set a test project
- basic hello-world app (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstart)
- list of prompts / SLA targets (optional)
CalendarBot: Created recurring event draft: "Kestrel cohort 2 — Onboarding drop-in" first occurrence 2025-06-04 17:00 UTC (10:00 PDT). Invite link: https://calendar.redwood.internal/event/abcd1234. Recurrence: weekly x6.
Sofia (Training): Thanks calendar bot. I'll upload the deck to Drive by Monday and add a short worksheet for the hands-on demo.
Evan (Customer Success Manager): One ask from Kestrel: they want a short post-session feedback form (3 questions) and a follow-up ticket for any action items. Can we add that to the agenda owner checklist?
Priya (CSM): Yep — Sofia, could you add the feedback form (Google Forms) and a sample follow-up template to the Drive folder? I'll collect action items into our CS tracker.
Sofia (Training): Will do. Draft questions: 1) Did the session help you move forward? 2) Which feature do you plan to adopt next? 3) Any blockers? Simple rating + freeform.
Noah (Solutions Eng): Also recommend a tiny lab exercise for attendees: set up a minimal batching config and observe latency/cost delta. I can write the step-by-step and post as a gist.
Priya (CSM): Perfect. Owner list:
- Lead session wk1-wk2: Noah
- Lead wk3+: Sofia/Evan rotation
- Slides & worksheet: Sofia
- Calendar invite & invites: CalendarBot / Priya to confirm recipients
- Post-session feedback form + follow-up template: Sofia / Priya
- Lab exercise gist: Noah
Jordan (PM): Suggest we pin a short FAQ in the invite about credentials and security for Private deployments. Helps reduce live questions.
Priya (CSM): Agreed. Action items: Noah to post gist by 2025-06-02; Sofia to upload slides + forms by 2025-06-02; Priya to confirm recipient list by EOD 2025-06-01.
Evan (Customer Success Manager): I'm good to be primary contact for any renewal/ops questions that arise during sessions.
Noah (Solutions Eng): One more thing — can we reserve a breakout room for up to 30 mins after the first session for deeper config calls? Some teams will want hands-on help.
Sofia (Training): I'll add a 30m optional breakout in the calendar event.
Priya (CSM): Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll finalize invite and send invites by EOD. :thumbsup:
Jordan (PM): LGTM
CalendarBot: Event "Kestrel cohort 2 — Onboarding drop-in" updated: breakout room added, Drive folder linked: https://drive.redwood.internal/folders/kestrel-cohort-2
